text: The cliff scan's jump, below the line: in year 10 (children of 18 and 22, support $25,000 each) the business pays each child $12,500, exactly one-half of support, so §1(g) still applies to both.

Above the line: $13,000 each. Earned income now exceeds one-half of support (§1(g)(2)(A)(ii)(II)) and the children's gains are taxed at their own 0% rate that year; $500 more wages each, worth $23,143 at the horizon.
